method: Same-agent English/Marathi block-by-block close reading, verification of each surveyed logic against its stated modelling purpose, and exact formula, macro, controlled-token, identifier and reference comparison. No independent human or native-speaker review is claimed.
scope: Designing formal logics; fuzzy, probabilistic, default, nonmonotonic, epistemic, causal and deontic logics; their disciplinary settings; and Leibniz's aspiration to reduce reason to calculation.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: A new logic can be built by choosing syntax, a deductive system and semantics, though completeness and broader mathematical interest require further work. Its mathematical and computational properties can then be explored.
samples.checks: The three design components, completeness qualification, public-interest qualification and both property classes are retained.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: Different formal logics model vagueness, uncertainty, revisable default inference, knowledge, causation and obligation. According to their motivation, they are studied in mathematical or philosophical logic, artificial intelligence, cognitive science and related fields.
samples.checks: Every named logic maps to the source's exact purpose, including the definition of defeasible inference as reasonable but overturnable with new information.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: The range of logics may be endless; even if Leibniz's dream of reducing all human reason to calculation is unattainable, it remains worth pursuing.
samples.checks: The open-ended survey, historical attribution, total scope of human reason and qualified conclusion are retained.

source_observations: All formulas, macros, controlled tokens, identifiers and references match the frozen source exactly.
The probability and epistemology components have direct official Marathi evidence, while most exact system labels in T268–T270 remain explicitly provisional.
लायप्निट्स is directly attested by the official Marathi Vishwakosh.
limitations: No independent human or native-speaker review has been performed.
The default, nonmonotonic, defeasible, causal, deontic and cognitive-science labels should receive specialist review.
No TeX reader build was run for this individual unit.
